mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (title, description, task_type, source_type, source_id, store_id, reward_type, reward_value, start_at, end_at, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{taskType}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{storeId}, #{rewardType}, #{rewardValue}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET title=#{title}, description=#{description}, task_type=#{taskType}, source_type=#{sourceType}, source_id=#{sourceId}, store_id=#{storeId}, reward_type=#{rewardType}, reward_value=#{rewardValue}, start_at=#{startAt}, end_at=#{endAt}, status=#{status}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, description, task_type, source_type, source_id, store_id, reward_type, reward_value, start_at, end_at, status, created_at, updated_at FROM task WHERE id=#{id}
